H3292.name: Akan
H3292.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3292.brief: Son of Ezer, a Horite chief in Seir
H3292.short: Akan was the son of Ezer, a Horite chief who lived in the land of Seir.

H3229.name: Imlah
H3229.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3229.short: Imlah was the father of Micaiah, a prophet who spoke the truth to King Ahab of Israel, despite the king's displeasure.

H3234.name: Imna
H3234.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3234.short: Imna was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

H3232H.name: Imnah
H3232H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3232H.short: Imnah, a Levite, was appointed as an overseer of the freewill offerings during the religious reforms of King Hezekiah.

H3232G.name: Imnah
H3232G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3232G.brief: A son of Asher and ancestor of the Imnites.
H3232G.short: Imnah was a son of Asher and the ancestor of the Imnite clan within the tribe of Asher.

H3236.name: Imrah
H3236.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3236.short: Imrah was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

H3252.name: Iscah
H3252.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3252.brief: Daughter of Haran, Milcah's sister, Lot's sister.
H3252.short: Iscah was the daughter of Haran and sister of Milcah and Lot.

H3253.name: Ismachiah
H3253.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3253.brief: Overseer under King Hezekiah during temple restoration.
H3253.short: Ismachiah was one of the overseers appointed by King Hezekiah during the restoration of the temple and its services.

H3291.name: Jaakobah
H3291.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3291.short: Jaakobah was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3279.name: Jaalah
H3279.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3279.brief: Returned exile; descendant of Solomon's servants.
H3279.short: Jaalah was among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3296.name: Jaare-oregim
H3296.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H3296.brief: Father of Elhanan, who killed Goliath's brother.
H3296.short: Jaare-oregim (or Jair) was the father of Elhanan, who killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite.

H3298.name: Jaareshiah
H3298.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3298.short: Jaareshiah was a descendant of Benjamin through Jeroham.

H3299.name: Jaasu
H3299.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3299.brief: Descendant of Bani; agreed to put away foreign wife.
H3299.short: Jaasu, a descendant of Bani, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

H3269.name: Jaaziah
H3269.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3269.brief: Levite, descendant of Merari during David's reign.
H3269.short: Jaaziah was a Levite, a descendant of Merari through his son Beno, who served during King David's reign.

H3268.name: Jaaziel
H3268.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3268.short: Jaaziel (or Aziel or Jeiel) was a Levite appointed as a musician to play the bronze cymbals during the bringing of the ark to Jerusalem in David's reign.

H3258H.name: Jabez
H3258H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3258H.brief: More honorable than his brothers; God granted his prayer.
H3258H.short: Jabez, who was more honorable than his brothers, cried out to God, who granted his request to enlarge his territory and keep him from harm.

H3275.name: Jacan
H3275.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3275.brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham.
H3275.short: Jacan was a leader from the tribe of Gad during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

H3278.name: Jael
H3278.brief: Wife of Heber; killed Sisera, the Canaanite commander.
H3278.short: Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, killed Sisera, the commander of the Canaanite army, by driving a tent peg through his temple.

H3281.name: Jalam
H3281.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3281.short: Jalam was a son of Esau and Oholibamah, and a chief of Edom.

H3210.name: Jalon
H3210.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3210.brief: Son of Ezrah, from the tribe of Judah
H3210.short: Jalon was a son of Ezrah, from the tribe of Judah.

H3226H.name: Jamin
H3226H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3226H.brief: Son of Ram, descendant of Judah
H3226H.short: Jamin was a son of Ram and a descendant of Judah.

H3226G.name: Jamin
H3226G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3226G.brief: Son of Simeon, grandson of Jacob
H3226G.short: Jamin was a son of Simeon and a grandson of Jacob.

H3226I.name: Jamin
H3226I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3226I.brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
H3226I.short: Jamin was a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

H3230.name: Jamlech
H3230.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3230.short: Jamlech was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during King Hezekiah's reign.

H3285.name: Janai
H3285.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3285.brief: Gadite leader who settled in Bashan
H3285.short: Janai was a leader from the tribe of Gad who settled in the region of Bashan.

H3203.name: Jecoliah
H3203.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3203.brief: Mother of King Uzziah (Azariah) of Judah
H3203.short: Jecoliah was the mother of King Uzziah (also known as Azariah) of Judah.

H3273H.name: Jeiel
H3273H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273H.brief: One of David's mighty men from Mahavite.
H3273H.short: Jeiel the Mahavite was listed among David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles.

H3273I.name: Jeiel
H3273I.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273I.brief: A Levite musician and gatekeeper during David's reign.
H3273I.short: Jeiel (or Jehiah) was a Levite who served as a musician and gatekeeper during the time of David, particularly in the transportation of the ark to Jerusalem.

H3273G.name: Jeiel
H3273G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273G.short: Jeiel was the head of a family in the tribe of Reuben, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3273J.name: Jeiel
H3273J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273J.brief: Grandfather of Jahaziel, a Levite during Jehoshaphat's reign.
H3273J.short: Jeiel was the grandfather of Jahaziel, a Levite who prophesied during the reign of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H3273K.name: Jeiel
H3273K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273K.brief: A scribe in King Uzziah's army.
H3273K.short: Jeiel was the scribe who recorded the number of soldiers in King Uzziah's army.

H3273M.name: Jeiel
H3273M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273M.brief: A Levite who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.
H3273M.short: Jeiel was one of the Levites who generously provided animals for King Josiah's Passover celebration.

H3273O.name: Jeiel
H3273O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3273O.brief: A descendant of Nebo who married a foreign wife.
H3273O.short: Jeiel, a descendant of Nebo, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

H3224.name: Jemimah
H3224.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3224.brief: One of Job's daughters born after his restoration.
H3224.short: Jemimah was the first of three daughters born to Job after God restored his fortunes, as recorded in the book of Job.

H3223.name: Jemuel
H3223.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3223.brief: Son of Simeon, also known as Nemuel.
H3223.short: Jemuel (or Nemuel) was a son of Simeon and a founder of the Nemuelite clan, as recorded in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

H3262.name: Jeuel
H3262.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3262.short: Jeuel, a descendant of Zerah, settled in Jerusalem.

H3273L.name: Jeuel
H3273L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3273L.brief: A Levite who helped cleanse the temple
H3273L.short: Jeuel, a Levite who assisted in cleansing the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H3273N.name: Jeuel
H3273N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3273N.brief: A descendant of Adonikam who returned from exile
H3273N.short: Jeuel, a descendant of Adonikam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H3266J.name: Jeush
H3266J.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3266J.brief: A Levite, son of Shimei or Shubael
H3266J.short: Jeush, a Levite, was a son of Shimei (or Shubael) during David's reign.

H3266H.name: Jeush
H3266H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3266H.brief: A descendant of Bilhan from the tribe of Benjamin
H3266H.short: Jeush, a Benjamite, was a descendant of Bilhan.

H3266I.name: Jeush
H3266I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3266I.brief: A descendant of Eleasah from the tribe of Benjamin
H3266I.short: Jeush, a Benjamite, was a son of Eleasah (or 'Eshek').

H3266K.name: Jeush
H3266K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3266K.brief: Son of King Rehoboam and Mahalath
H3266K.short: Jeush was a son of King Rehoboam and his wife Mahalath.

H3266G.name: Jeush
H3266G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3266G.short: Jeush, a son of Esau and Oholibamah, was a chief of Edom.

H3263.name: Jeuz
H3263.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3263.brief: A descendant of Shaharaim from the tribe of Benjamin
H3263.short: Jeuz was a Benjamite, born to Shaharaim in the country of Moab.

H3247G.name: Foundation Gate
H3247G.brief: Gate in Jerusalem's wall; location of Levite singers during coronation
H3247G.short: The Foundation Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, where a third of the Levite singers were positioned during the coronation of Joash.

H3258G.name: Jabez
H3258G.brief: A place associated with the families of scribes
H3258G.short: Jabez, a place associated with the families of scribes (<ref="1Ch.2.55">1Ch.2.55</ref>).

H3241.name: Janim
H3241.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H3241.short: Janim, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:53">Joshua 15:53</ref>).

H3239A.name: Janoah
H3239A.brief: A town captured by the Assyrians from Israel
H3239A.short: Janoah, a town captured by the Assyrians during the reign of Pekah, king of Israel (<ref="2Ki.15.29">2Ki.15.29</ref>).

H3239B.name: Janoah
H3239B.brief: A town on the border of Ephraim
H3239B.short: Janoah, a town on the border of Ephraim's territory (<ref="Joshua 16:6,7">Joshua 16:6,7</ref>).

H3270G.name: Jazer
H3270G.brief: A town in Gilead, allotted to Gad
H3270G.short: Jazer, a town in Gilead, allotted to Gad, known for its fertile land and vineyards.

H3270H.name: Jazer Sea
H3270H.brief: A poetic reference to the abundant vineyards of Jazer
H3270H.short: The Sea of Jazer, a poetic reference to the abundant vineyards of Jazer (<ref="Jeremiah 48:32">Jeremiah 48:32</ref>).

H3277G.name: Wildgoats Rocks
H3277G.brief: A place near En Gedi where David hid from Saul
H3277G.short: Wildgoats Rocks, a rugged area near En Gedi where David hid from Saul and had the opportunity to spare the king's life (<ref="1Sam. 24:2">1Sam. 24:2</ref>).
